### Provenance

- Tied-embeddings usage (Chapter 2) has no dedicated primary source; the sandwich-norm claim (Chapter 2) leans on a secondary source rather than a model's own technical report. Both are tracked sourcing gaps, not unsupported claims.
- All worked-example numbers in Chapters 1-6 (attention weights, parameter counts, KV-cache sizes, receptive fields, MoE parameter/routing counts, the ch. 6 hypothetical-config GQA group size and expert fraction) are computed by version-controlled project scripts and checked by the project's automated test suite, not hand-derived.
- Figures are generated from version-controlled scripts using a fixed visual-style configuration, not drawn freehand; each figure's caption credits its scholarly/technical source where one applies.
- Chapter 3's and Chapter 4's KV-cache/latent-cache/attention-projection-parameter figures and formulas are LOGICAL, theoretical minimums, not measured GPU memory -- they exclude allocator overhead, page metadata, fragmentation, and framework buffers.
- Chapter 4's MLA content (compression formula, decoupled-RoPE reasoning, cache-per-token table) was verified directly against DeepSeek-V2's full paper text ([@src-27], Sections 2.1.1-2.1.4 and Table 1), not a search-result snippet.
- Chapter 5's shared-experts claim was verified directly against DeepSeekMoE's full paper text ([@src-36], arXiv:2401.06066), not a snippet or blog summary; detailed distributed-training implementation, collective-communication algorithms, kernel optimization, inference-engine configuration, expert quantization, model-specific benchmark comparisons, post-training, and routing-research surveys are all deferred.
- Chapter 6's three case-study models (Llama 3 405B [@src-32], DeepSeek-V3 [@src-33], Jamba [@src-35]) and the Mamba mechanism source [@src-37] were each verified by downloading the primary source PDF and extracting its full text (pdftotext), not by trusting a search snippet or a fetch tool's own summary -- resolving the sourcing gap Chapter 4 had left open for the recurrent/SSM mechanism family. The Llama 3 405B config.json on Hugging Face is gated and was not used; all Llama 3 figures come from the paper's own Table 3 and Section 3.2.1 text.
- Chapter 6 selects exactly three model families (one dense, one sparse-MoE-with-compressed-attention, one hybrid) as representative case studies, not an exhaustive survey; Mixtral remains registered only as a ch. 5-adjacent supporting reference, not a fourth main case study.
